artworks.title: The Impossible
artworks.description: The image depicts a muscular man pulling on a tree while in an active stance. He has a pronounced beard and curly hair, and is minimally clothed. The background shows a natural setting with trees, foliage, and rocks. The word "IMPOSSIBILE" is inscribed on a branch in the image.

artworks.title: The Lady and Death
artworks.description: In the image, there are two figures standing closely together. The left figure is a woman in a long, detailed dress with a patterned cap and gathered fabric around her neck. The figure on the right is skeletal, wearing a hood and holding an hourglass and bouquet of flowers. A wooden fence and a plant in a vase are in the background. The image includes engraved text with the date "1541" and initials "IsB" at the top and left side.

artworks.title: Death and Three Nude Women
artworks.description: The image shows four figures displayed from head to toe. Three are fully nude women, and one is a skeleton. The women have nondescript facial features - one with hair tied back, one with braided hair, and one with loose flowing hair. No clothing is visible. One woman faces the viewer, while others face each other or the skeleton. The skeleton stands in the back-left, facing the women. The women have different postures - one mostly back to the viewer, one sideways with a cloth on her arm, and one facing the skeleton. Near their feet are a disembodied head and other unclear objects. The background is plain with textured hatch shading, emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: Peasants' Feast
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a table with a meal served. The illustration depicts figures dressed in traditional attire around a wooden table with food on it. Some figures are engaging in conversation, while one figure reaches towards another with a container raised. The background includes a decorative arch with leaves and grapes. The scene is detailed with intricate line work in an engraving style, and it includes a speech scroll with text.

artworks.title: Peasant at Market
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright. He leans on a staff with his left hand and holds a sword or large knife in his right hand. He has detailed facial features, a stern expression, and wears a textured tunic, a belt, and a hat with a feather. Nearby are a large sack, ceramic vessels, and a scroll with text that reads “DETEN WIR VERKAUFEN.”

artworks.title: Two Street Players and a Girl
artworks.description: The image displays three individuals playing wind instruments. The characters are standing closely together in a side profile with slight overlap, focusing on playing their instruments. Each person's full body is visible. The first person on the left wears a pointed hat with a wide brim, a cloak with a belted waist, and trousers. The middle person is adorned with a wreath-like headpiece and a tunic with a patterned hem, playing the bagpipes. The third person on the right wears a simple cap and a flowing garment with linear detailing. The background features a simple, cross-hatched design, without additional scenery. A small "I. S. P." is printed in the top-right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman Going to Market
artworks.description: The image depicts a person walking to the right in profile. They wear a headscarf, cloak, tunic, and boots, carrying an earthenware jug on their back, an ostrich under one arm, and a bag tied to their waist. The background includes simple linework of a bush or tree and an ornamental plant. Marked with the year 1530 and the initials "HSP."

artworks.title: Three Soldiers and a Dog
artworks.description: The image shows three figures and a dog. One figure on the left wears a large hat and a beard. The central figure has their back turned slightly to the right, wearing a long cloak. The figure on the right holds a staff or weapon, possibly a halberd, and wears protective headgear. The scene is detailed with textural lines emphasizing fabric folds and material textures. The setting appears historical, indicating a moment of consultation or planning. The style suggests a woodcut or engraving.

artworks.title: Standard Bearer and Drummer
artworks.description: The image features two individuals in detailed etching. One person is on the left, holding a drum with one arm and a drumstick in the other hand. They wear a cap, tunic, and armor. The person on the right, facing left, has curly hair under a wide-brimmed hat and wears a textured tunic, boots, and a sword at the belt. They hold a stick. The background has textured patterns and inscriptions.

artworks.title: Standard Bearer
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.3 x 5 cm (2 7/8 x 1 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright, turned slightly to the left. He has a distinct facial expression with defined eyebrows, a mustache, and a beard. His curly hair is covered by an elaborate hat, and he wears a detailed garment with padded components and wide puffed sleeves. He holds a sword in his left hand and a shovel over his right shoulder. A textured cloak billows out behind him. In the background are subtle landscape elements, such as a tree and plants. A plinth beside him indicates the date of the image as 1536.

artworks.title: Foot Soldier Standing by a Tree
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright, facing slightly to the right, with one arm resting on a long staff or pole, while the other hand is placed on their hip. The individual has facial features, including a prominent nose and a mustache, and styled or covered hair with a hat adorned with a large plume. They are dressed in a detailed outfit consisting of a doublet and hose with decorative elements. The person is also wearing footwear consistent with the outfit and has a sword at their side. The background features trees, vegetation, and hills or mountains in the distance. The illustration is an etching or engraving with the date "1520" and initials "ISP" in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Bust of a Young Woman
artworks.description: This image shows a person's head and shoulders in a slightly tilted position. The facial features are detailed with a neutral expression, and the hair is styled in layers framing the face and extending to the neck. The person is wearing a draped garment. In the background, there are faint lines and shading. The artwork is dated 1518, with the initials "I & P" inscribed beside the figure.

artworks.title: Two Couples and a Fool
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a group of people conversing. The scene features several individuals in ornate clothing sitting closely together in a setting with detailed flora. The drawing showcases intricate details, including textures, folds of clothing, and hand gestures. The style appears to be influenced by artists from the Renaissance or early modern graphic art.

artworks.title: Fool and Two Bathing Women
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in an outdoor setting. The person on the left is partially seen from the waist up, reclining in a wooden tub with an arched opening above. They have intricately braided hair and a focused facial expression as they reach towards the person next to them. The middle individual is dressed in a long-sleeved garment and is depicted holding a man wearing a helmet and some sort of robe, who appears partially submerged in a circular tub. The third individual is fully shown, with curly hair. They are positioned to the right, standing on the ground, partially obscured by the tub. An elaborate decorative pitcher sits in the foreground, and a large jug is placed behind the middle figure. The background features a simple setting with a potted plant on a shelf and small rocks on the ground. The setting suggests an outdoor space with natural elements like a tree visible above the wooden structure.

artworks.title: The Penance of Saint John Chrysostom
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a landscape with a reclining female figure and child, along with a castle in the background. The image features a serene landscape with a nude female figure lying on her side next to a child standing beside her. The background includes trees, hills, and a castle under a partly cloudy sky. The engraving shows complex textures such as the stone of the castle, the shading of the human forms, and details of the natural landscape. The inscription at the top reads "S. Iohanes. Crisostomus."

artworks.title: The Shepherd
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated man reclined against a rock or fur-covered surface. His head is inclined to the left, resting on his left hand. He has curly hair and a beard. The man is partially clothed in a rustic garment and is surrounded by tall grass, rocks, and animal skin or fur. In the background, there is a landscape with a fortified town, towers, and mountains.

artworks.title: Profile Study of Two Horse Heads
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse's head with a geometric framework. The left side shows a diagrammatic representation of a horse's head framed by geometric lines and shapes, illustrating a method of constructing proportions. On the right side, there is a detailed depiction of the horse's head, with intricate mane curls and emphasis on musculature and features like the eye and nostrils.

artworks.title: Two Profile Studies of a Man's Head
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man's head and neck in profile. The man is facing right with a grid structure on the left side displaying the same profile. His face features include a slightly pronounced brow, straight nose, and full lips. He has short hair with visible texture lines. He is depicted without clothing except for a faint line at the base of his neck. There is no jewelry or objects in the image. The background has parallel lines, with text reading "EINES MANNES HAVPT" above and a shield with "1542" and "HsB" between the two profiles.

artworks.title: Two Profile Studies of a Woman's Head
artworks.description: The image displays two side profiles of a head, one on the left and another on the right. The left drawing shows a head with facial features inside a grid system. The right drawing depicts a detailed profile of the same head, highlighting the facial features and hair texture. The profile shows a clean-shaven face, a straight nose, and defined lips, with short slightly wavy hair. The head and part of the neck are visible without clothing. The background has a shaded, cross-hatched texture, and there is text at the top that reads "EINES WEIBES HAUPT." At the bottom right corner, the date "1542" and the initials "ISB" are inscribed.

artworks.title: Three Medals with Portraits
artworks.description: Three portraits are displayed horizontally. Each is a bust-length profile of different individuals within circular frames. The left portrait shows a man facing right with closely cropped hair and a sturdy neck. His features include a prominent nose and distinct lips and chin. He wears a garment with a collar, and the frame includes the text "Ulrich Gebhardt." In the middle portrait, another person faces right wearing a tight headdress and high-collared top. The right portrait depicts a man facing right with a pointed beard and styled hair, wearing a fur-collared garment. None wear jewelry. The background features textured surfaces within the circular frames and surrounding area.

artworks.title: Ornament with a Couple of Tritons Blowing Horns
artworks.description: This is an illustration of two mythological creatures playing instruments. The image shows two mirrored satyr-like figures facing each other, each playing a wind instrument, with a vase-like object between them. Their bodies are detailed with leaf-like textures and their wings are prominently displayed. Floral motifs and intricate scrollwork decorate the borders. The drawing is detailed with precise linework and shading, adding depth to the figures and decorative elements.
